app.name: Widgets
app.subtitle: Omarchy shell settings
side.title: Sections
bar.position.desc: Screen edge the bar sits on.
bar.transparent.desc: No background: the wallpaper shows through. You can also double-click the empty center of the bar.
bar.centerAnchor.desc: This widget sits at the exact center of the bar and the other center widgets flank it. "None" centers the whole group.
bar.id.desc: An alternative full bar (a plugin of kind "bar") replaces Omarchy's built-in bar.
bar.tip: Tip: on the bar itself you can drag empty space to move it to another edge and drag widgets to reorder them. This tool picks those changes up.
lay.custom_command: Custom module showing the output of a command.
lay.tip: Enter: settings · n: add · d: remove · ⇧+arrows or mouse drag: move
w.unknown: Widget not found in the catalog (uninstalled plugin?). The shell will ignore it.
w.no_settings: This widget has no configurable settings.
w.only_advanced: This widget's settings are only shown in advanced mode (press m).
w.raw_desc: JSON value (text, number, true/false, list or object).
cw.exec.desc: Runs with bash. It may print plain text or Waybar-style JSON: {"text": "…", "tooltip": "…", "class": "…"}.
cw.interval.desc: How often the command runs again.
cw.text.desc: Text shown when the command prints nothing (or there is no command).
cw.keepSpace.desc: Keep the module's slot even when it shows no text.
cw.horizontalMargin.desc: Space on each side of the text, in pixels.
cw.verticalPadding.desc: Top and bottom padding on vertical bars, in pixels.
cw.format.desc: How the date/time is shown on horizontal bars. Right-clicking the clock cycles formats.
cw.formatAlt.desc: Format shown when toggling with a click.
cw.verticalFormat.desc: Format for left/right bars (each line is stacked).
cw.weekStartDay.desc: Day the calendar popup starts on. Automatic = from the system locale.
cw.birthYear.desc: Optional: enables the life calendar in the clock popup.
cw.lifeExpectancy.desc: Years used by the life calendar.
cw.unit.desc: Automatic = from your country and locale.
cw.refreshMinutes.desc: How often the weather is fetched.
cw.size.desc: Width of the blank space (height on vertical bars).
cw.showPercentage.desc: Show the battery percentage next to the icon. Right click also toggles it.
idle.screensaver.desc: Idle time before the screensaver starts.
idle.lock.desc: Idle time before the session locks (counted from when idle began, not from the screensaver).
idle.summary: Now: screensaver after {saver} and lock after {lock} of inactivity.
idle.warn_order: The session will lock before the screensaver starts.
idle.tip: Dismissing the screensaver before the lock deadline cancels the lock. To pause it temporarily use "Stay awake" in the Omarchy menu.
ap.tip: Grey values come from the current theme; changes are saved to ~/.config/omarchy/shell.toml and apply to any theme. Press r to go back to the theme value.
ap.tip_advanced: Every key from the theme's shell.toml. Changes are saved to ~/.config/omarchy/shell.toml (it wins over the theme). r = back to the theme value. Colors take #RRGGBB or references such as hyprland.active-border.
ap.no_theme: The current theme's shell.toml was not found (~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme). Is Omarchy installed?
ap.font.base-size.desc: Type scale for the whole shell (bar, menus, notifications). With "scale with font" the bar and spacing grow too.
ap.spacing.scale.desc: Multiplies margins, gaps and panel sizes (1.0 = normal).
ap.bar.size-horizontal.desc: Height in pixels of a top/bottom bar (at font size 12).
ap.bar.size-vertical.desc: Width in pixels of a left/right bar (at font size 12).
ap.popups.background-alpha.desc: Panels opened from the bar. 0 = invisible, 1 = opaque.
ap.menu.background-alpha.desc: Omarchy menu, clipboard and emojis. 0 = invisible, 1 = opaque.
ch.backups: A backup is written to {dir} before saving.
pl.add.hint: Git repository URL (it needs a manifest.json at its root). The plugin lands disabled so you can review it first.
pl.clone.only_builtin: Only Omarchy plugins can be customized (cloned).
pl.update.not_git: Only plugins installed from git can be updated.
pl.remove.builtin: Omarchy plugins can't be removed; disable them instead.
pl.edit.builtin: Omarchy plugins aren't edited in place: clone with p and edit the clone.
pl.warn_unsandboxed: Third-party plugins run unsandboxed inside the shell: only install code you trust.
msg.title: Notice
msg.builtin_bar_always: The built-in bar is turned off by choosing another bar.
msg.json_invalid: Your shell.json is not valid JSON ({err}). Factory values are shown; applying will replace it (with a backup).
msg.toml_invalid: Your shell.toml is not valid ({err}). Applying will replace it (with a backup).
msg.using_defaults: You are still on Omarchy's factory configuration. Applying changes will create your ~/.config/omarchy/shell.json.
msg.reloaded_external: The configuration changed outside meca-qs; reloaded.
msg.pending_first: Apply (a) or discard (c) your pending changes first.
msg.applied: Changes applied ✓ The shell is already using them.
msg.applied_no_shell: Changes saved. The shell is not running: they will be used when it starts.
msg.applied_sandbox: Changes saved to the sandbox directory.
msg.applied_with_errors: Changes were saved, but there were problems:
msg.shell_not_running_ops: The shell is not running: cloned plugins could not be enabled/disabled.
mode.advanced_on: Advanced mode: every option is shown.
input.raw_hint: JSON value: "text", 42, true, ["a","b"]… If it isn't valid JSON it is stored as text.
input.text_hint: Use \n for line breaks. Empty = default value.
input.date_hint: Qt format: d dd ddd dddd (day) · M MM MMM MMMM (month) · yy yyyy · H HH h hh · mm · ss · AP · ww (week) · 'literal text'.
input.module_id_hint: Unique module id (letters, digits, - _ .). E.g. vpn, gpu, cpu-temp.
confirm.discard.title: Discard changes
confirm.discard: All pending changes will be lost.
confirm.quit.title: Quit
confirm.quit: There are unapplied changes. Quit and discard them?
confirm.restart: The shell will restart (the bar disappears for a moment).
conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.body: {files} was modified outside meca-qs (for example by dragging a widget on the bar) while you had pending changes.
conflict.keys: o: overwrite with my changes · r: reload and lose my changes · Esc: cancel
add.title: Add widget to {section}
add.command.desc: Shows the output of a command or script and runs actions on click.
add.qml.desc: Your own widget written in QML (~/.config/omarchy/bar/modules/<id>.qml).
help.title: Help
help.change: Change the value (toggle, next option, ± step)
help.w.move: Move the widget (between sections or within one)
help.w.remove: Remove the widget from the bar
help.w.drag: Click to select, double-click for settings, drag to move
help.p.toggle: Enable / disable (or put on / take off the bar)
help.p.clone: Customize: clone an Omarchy plugin into your config
help.modes: Simple mode: just the essentials, with descriptions and suggested values. Advanced mode: every option, raw shell.json keys, custom modules, the whole shell.toml and tools.
cli.about: TUI panel to configure Quickshell's bar, widgets and plugins on Omarchy.
cli.section: open a section directly: bar, widgets, plugins, idle, appearance, changes
confirm.disable.title: Disable {name}?
confirm.disable: This is an Omarchy system component. Disabling it may break parts of the desktop (screen lock, notifications, password prompts…). You can re-enable it here.
bar.anchor_missing: The anchored widget isn't in the center section, so anchoring has no effect. Pick another one or "None".
btn.apply.desc: Save the {n} pending change(s) (with a backup).
btn.cancel.desc: Discard pending changes and go back to what is saved.
restore.bar.desc: Position, transparency and the anchored widget go back to Omarchy's factory values, and the built-in bar is used.
restore.layout.desc: The bar goes back to Omarchy's factory widgets and order. Added widgets and their settings are removed.
restore.widget.desc: All of this widget's settings are removed and it uses its defaults.
restore.plugins.desc: Omarchy components that were disabled are enabled again and the built-in bar is used. Your installed plugins are untouched.
restore.idle.desc: Back to factory values: screensaver after 2 min 30 s and lock after 5 min.
restore.appearance.desc: Your main appearance settings are removed and the theme values come back.
restore.appearance_all.desc: Every setting in your shell.toml is removed: everything goes back to the theme values.
restore.all.desc: The whole shell configuration (bar, widgets, plugins, idle and appearance) goes back to Omarchy's factory values.
restore.note: Nothing is saved yet: review the result and press Apply to save it or Cancel to undo it.
msg.restored: Restored. Press Apply to save it or Cancel to undo it.
ch.use_buttons: Use the buttons below to apply or cancel these changes.
help.restore: Restore factory values for the current screen
msg.restored_nothing: Already at factory values: nothing to apply.
sec.bar.desc: Where the bar sits and how it looks.
sec.widgets.desc: Which widgets the bar shows, in what order and with which settings.
sec.plugins.desc: Shell components: enable, disable or install new ones.
sec.idle.desc: When the screensaver starts and when the session locks.
sec.appearance.desc: Font size, spacing and opacity of the shell.
sec.changes.desc: Review what you are about to change before applying it.
hint.mode: Click to switch between simple and advanced mode.
hint.lang: Click to switch the language (Spanish / English).
hint.click_toggle: click to turn on or off
hint.click_choose: click to pick from the list
hint.click_slide: click or drag on the bar to adjust
hint.click_step: use − and + or click the number to type it
hint.slider: Click or drag to pick the value.
hint.widget: click to select, double-click for settings, drag to move, right-click for more.
hint.column: Drop a widget here to move it to this section.
hint.add_widget: Add a widget at the end of this section.
hint.plugin: Click to select · double-click or the switch to toggle · right-click for more.
hint.plugin_switch: Click to turn on or off.
help.menu: Context menu for the selected item
help.m.hover.desc: Highlights the item and explains it in the bottom bar.
help.m.click.desc: Selects; on a control it changes it (switch, −/+, slider, list).
help.m.right.desc: Menu with the item's actions (also with the o key).
help.m.wheel.desc: Scrolls the list; over the left panel it changes section.
